Fitting a model means finding the parameters that make the observed data most
likely. Try it yourself: drag the sliders to fit a line to the data. \
The app runs in your browser and takes a few seconds to load. It is an [R Shiny](https://shiny.posit.co/) app,
and can be run [locally](#run-the-app-on-your-own-computer) (on your computer) for a smoother experience.
